articles.title: Venezuelan Soccer Pro Detained for Months Despite Pending Immigration Cases
articles.summary: Homero Calderón, a professional soccer player from Venezuela, has been in ICE detention for nearly six months after a traffic stop. He had two pending immigration applications, but that didn't protect him from arrest. His case highlights a massive backlog of 11.3 million pending cases at USCIS.

articles.title: Erdogan Says Egypt Could Join New Turkey-Saudi-Pakistan Defense Pact
articles.summary: Turkish President Erdogan says Egypt could join the newly signed Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, a pact between Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan that treats an attack on one as an attack on all. The deal, signed last Friday, is open to more members, Erdogan said in an exclusive interview.

articles.title: Trump Administration Wants Private Companies to Hack Foreign Cybercriminals
articles.summary: A new presidential memo could authorize U.S. businesses to hack foreign cybercriminals—a job traditionally done by government agencies. The plan would let companies disrupt networks and gather intelligence, but legal details remain unclear. Some experts call it a dramatic departure from current practice.
